'''Cheng Rongshi''' ({{zh|s=程镕时}}; 18 October 1927 – 7 February 2021) was a Chinese physical chemist and academician of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]].<ref name="celery">{{cite news|author1=Zhong Yuhao ({{lang|zh|钟煜豪}})|url=https://www.thepaper.cn/newsDetail_forward_11271634 |trans-title=Wang Shouguan, Shen Zhonghou, Cheng Rongshi, China has lost three academicians in 2021 |script-title=zh:王绶琯、沈忠厚、程镕时，2021年共和国已送别3位院士 |work=thepaper.cn |date=8 February 2021 |access-date=8 February 2021 |language=zh}}</ref>

==Biography==
Cheng was born in [[Yixing]], [[Jiangsu]], on 18 October 1927.<ref name="cat"/> In 1945, he was admitted to the [[University of Nanking (defunct in 1952)|University of Nanking]], where he studied chemistry under {{ill|Dai Anbang|zh|戴安邦}}.<ref name="cat"/> After graduating in 1949, he did his postgraduate work at [[Peking University]].<ref name="cat"/>

In 1951, Cheng was dispatched to the Shanghai Institute of Physical Chemistry, Chinese Academy of Sciences.<ref name="celery"/> That same year, he moved to [[Changchun]] and worked at Changchun Institute of Applied Chemistry. In 1983, he joined the faculty of [[Nanjing University]].<ref name="celery"/> In 1995, he became a professor and director of Macromolecule Research Institute of [[South China University of Technology]].<ref name="celery"/>

On 7 February 2021, he died of illness in [[Guangzhou]], [[Guangdong]], aged 93.<ref name="cat">{{cite news|author1=Li Yuan ({{lang|zh|李苑}})|url=http://news.sciencenet.cn/htmlnews/2021/2/452994.shtm |script-title=zh:我国高分子物理学科开拓者之一程镕时院士逝世|trans-title=Academician Cheng Rongshi, one of the pioneers of polymer physics in China, is dead|work=sciencenet.cn |date=8 February 2021 |access-date=8 February 2021 |language=zh}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|editor1=Yang Jie ({{lang|zh|杨杰}})|url=https://news.sina.com.cn/c/2021-02-08/doc-ikftssap4796776.shtml |trans-title=Academician Cheng Rongshi, one of the pioneers of polymer physics in China, dies at age 93 |script-title=zh:中国高分子物理学科开拓者程镕时院士逝世，享年93岁 |work=sina |date=8 February 2021 |access-date=8 February 2021 |language=zh}}</ref>
